# M3 collection canonical source snapshot

This finite versioned snapshot extends the existing Synexia vendor owner without changing its older seed. It retains the four exact canonical engines, collection recipe resources, frozen proof/oracle custody, original licences and execution evidence. Synexia remains the canonical portable recipe owner.

The final product recipe is `com.synexia.m3.M3JdkCollectionCurrentOwners20261017`. The existing `com.m3.collections.M3FilteredViews` receives only two qualified private refinements and its current mutable owner remains unchanged. Optional `jdk.m3.collections` exports only the new `com.m3.util` primitive projections. Earlier prospective duplicate generic facade resources are retained solely as unpromoted history for the former no-owner pin.

See `synexia-openrewrite-recipes/docs/m3-collections-20261017/delivery/README.md` for authoritative current-base proof and remaining gates. Current JNI/JMOD/image and independent wrapper checks pass. Full original collection Maven remains blocked by three identical M3LongTreeSetTest failures reproduced on the untouched current base. No full custom JDK promotion is asserted.

The bounded Maven SDK proof is `synexia-openrewrite-recipes/verification/m3-build-shared-ast-20261017/pom.xml`. With Java21 and its documented Maven dependencies available, run it with `-Dm3.crate=<exact crate>`, `-Dm3.kind=java` or `text`, `-Dm3.input=<exact input tree>` and `-Dm3.output=<fresh output>` plus `verify`. The private baseline portable sources are retained as evidence-only `.java.txt` files; their final postimages and all final receiving resources are included. No private GitHub access is needed for recipe source inspection or exact replay from those inputs.

SOURCE_CUSTODY.json supplies per-file content identity. The unrelated historical full Synexia ledger and this snapshot's own installer templates are excluded, keeping the source set finite. The final installer is canonical in Synexia and was executed separately through the unchanged SDK.
